gloss: to turn back, to go back

definitions.gloss: to turn back, to go back
definitions.explanation: To return the way one came; to go back to the starting point.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}を{間違|まちが}えたので{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I turned back because I took the wrong road.

examples.japanese: {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}に{気|き}づいて{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I turned back when I realized I forgot something.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{悪|わる}くなったので{山頂|さんちょう}から{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: We turned back from the summit because the weather got bad.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す means to turn back or return the way one came.

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {引|ひ}く (to pull) + {返|かえ}す (to return). The {引|ひ}き emphasizes the physical action of turning around.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- No transitive pair

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {道|みち}を{間違|まちが}えて{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to turn back after taking the wrong road
- {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}を{取|と}りに{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to go back to get something forgotten
- {途中|とちゅう}で{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to turn back partway

CONTRAST:
- {戻|もど}る: to return (general, to a place)
- {引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to turn back (emphasizes reversing direction)
